summary: TRACK 16.04 Transportation Foundation Phase 1 — backend + frontend tested end-to-end. All 24 static regression pytest cases pass; live API smoke covers every contract in the review request (RBAC, CRUD, duplicates, eligibility, dispatch read-as-admin and read-as-dispatch, anonymous 401). Frontend /admin/transportation renders the 4 tabs (Carriers / Drivers / Trucks / Eligibility) with data-testid coverage and shows the created test carrier in the table.
critical_code_review_comments: transportation.py overrides the injected require_dispatch_or_admin_dep with a local gate (lines 269-299). Intentional and documented as Phase-1 workaround for the retired sync admin validator, but worth a follow-up to retire the shared factory and remove the override.
_audit() is best-effort (swallows all exceptions and only logs a warning). Acceptable for Phase 1 but make sure Phase 2 add observability if audit writes start silently failing.
_hr_lifecycle_active returns None on absent employee row → eligibility stays 'eligible'. Documented Phase-1 behavior; revisit in Phase 2 once HR canonical is enforced.
test_credentials: Super admin jaymn.judd@mascigc.com / Maddix123! (multi-login → portal_tokens.admin); Dispatch dispatch@mascigc.com / DispatchTest2026! (POST /api/dispatch/login → token).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 carrier (TEST_CARRIER_TA_<ts>) and 1 leased driver under it during live smoke; both patched to status=inactive at the end (soft-delete pattern). No production data touched (preview DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 is solid. Live smoke checks executed: anon→401, dispatch token on admin write→401, admin list 200, carrier create 200, duplicate-active-legal-name 409, masci_employee without employee_id→422, leased_driver without carrier_id→422, duplicate-license under same carrier→409, leased truck without carrier_id→422, leased truck with non-existent carrier_id→404, GET eligibility 200, GET dispatch eligible-drivers with admin token→200, with dispatch token→200, anon→401, PATCH status=inactive for cleanup→200. UI /admin/transportation rendered with all 4 tabs and Carriers table populated. data-testid coverage verified for tab-carriers/tab-drivers/tab-trucks/tab-eligibility and carriers-table; non-active tabs are lazy so their *-table testids only appear on click — expected behavior. The 'Add Carrier' button shows by text but the carriers-add-button testid was not exposed in this DOM walk; if main agent wants strict testid-driven add-flow tests, confirm/standardize that testid name on the button.
